songs.title: Going to Queens
songs.lyric: "I felt the wind come through the window / I felt it turn around and switch back / in the second story room / in Jamaica Queens"

songs.title: Let Me Bathe in Demonic Light
songs.lyric: "I emerge in Manhattan, still young and strong"

songs.title: Down Here
songs.lyric: "Johnson Johnsin is my name / Brooklyn is my station"

songs.title: Genesis 19:1-2
songs.lyric: "The butcher from Brooklyn, the butcher's wife"

songs.title: Lovecraft in Brooklyn
albums: The Jordan Lake Sessions: Volumes 1 and 2
songs.lyric: "Hubcaps on the car like fun house mirrors / Stick to the shadows when I can / Lovecraft in Brooklyn"

songs.title: Harlem Roulette
songs.lyric: "Frankie Lymon's tracking "Seabreeze in a studio in Harlem / It's 1968"

songs.title: Then the Letting Go
songs.lyric: "Down in the South Bronx / Down home / Saw you walking down the street again / Saw you looking sweet again"
